findings.description: Section 3 first proposes a text-to-speech tool for playback, then says to ask “the helper or tool what it heard”; ordinary text-to-speech does not evaluate learner speech, so the tool reference is ambiguous even though the target-language model is sound.
findings.recommendation: In a future revision, distinguish a playback/TTS tool from an independent listener or speech-recognition tool.

limitations: This is an independent AI development review, not human review, release approval, or CEFR certification.
The review is limited to the supplied immutable lesson, audit, capture, authorized M5 context, and local repository materials.
No Internet-wide plagiarism search or external pronunciation recording assessment was performed.
